author: CBR
description:
In this Heroes Journey clip, we debate whether Matt Reeves’ The Batman should ever introduce a Robin, or if Robin belongs in James Gunn’s DCU with The Brave and the Bold. 

Robin still hasn’t been done properly on the big screen, and DC shouldn’t force a sidekick into Reeves’ grounded universe. 

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 19.
